color.note: Dark is the shipped theme and stays first; light is new and equal. chart-* tokens are the engine/pack theme hand-off: the engine draws the canvas, CSS cannot restyle it. Accent matches the workspace sample (periwinkle in dark, royal blue in light). Its smallest colour-blind difference from any other identity colour is DeltaE 10 (dark) and 12 (light), both against chart-up under deutan or tritan vision, so the accent is never the only signal: agents are squircles with an M, and up candles are hollow.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel; also the chart canvas ground (see chart-bg).

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Panels: chart panel, top bar, dialogs, cards on the page.

tokens.name: surface-150
tokens.usage: Raised areas inside a panel: right rail body, toolbar rows, cards in the rail, composer.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for quiet buttons, tabs and list rows. Never a resting surface.

tokens.name: border-100
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and inside cards. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-200
tokens.usage: Panel and card outlines. Below 3:1 by design (structure, not meaning).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, checkboxes, default buttons and chips. 3:1 on surface-100/150 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, values. On surface-000, -100, -150, -200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, meta rows, axis-like labels, timestamps. 4.5:1 on surface-000/100/150 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Two meanings only: an agent (squircle ring, running state, proposals) and the primary action's fill. Never selection, 'on' or 'current' states; those are surface-200 with an ink mark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills; in light it darkens.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text or icon: agent names and mentions, the woven S of the wordmark, links.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Agent avatar fill. Not for selected rows, tabs or chips (they use surface-200).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px. Over 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Text/icon for stale, reconnecting, needs attention, proposed-not-applied. On surfaces and caution-wash.

tokens.name: caution-wash
tokens.usage: Background for caution notices and the Needs attention chip.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Text/icon for saved, connected, completed, demo data present. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: good-wash
tokens.usage: Background for good-state chips.

tokens.name: refusal
tokens.usage: Text/icon for refusals and failures: not stored, stale data refused, basis mismatch, not permitted, failed. Always with a word and the refusal glyph; never hue alone.

tokens.name: refusal-wash
tokens.usage: Background for refusal notices.

tokens.name: anchor
tokens.usage: Ring of a drawing handle only while it is being dragged (UI side). Same hue as caution on purpose: both mean 'not settled yet'. A settled, selected handle uses chart-anchor (ink).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the sign-in dialog (with an 8px blur).

tokens.name: veil-retained
tokens.usage: Laid over the last drawn chart frame whenever it is not current (updating >300ms, reconnecting, failed, sign-in). Never used for decoration.

tokens.name: chart-bg
tokens.usage: Canvas background. Engine/pack theme value.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines. Engine.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis labels and tick text drawn by the engine (4.5:1 on chart-bg).

tokens.name: chart-crosshair
tokens.usage: Crosshair lines and the axis value tags' fill.

tokens.name: chart-up
tokens.usage: Up candle/bar: drawn HOLLOW (outline only). Blue-orange pair is safe for red-green colour blindness; fill-vs-outline carries direction without colour.

tokens.name: chart-down
tokens.usage: Down candle/bar: drawn FILLED. Pairs with chart-up.

tokens.name: chart-up-conventional
tokens.usage: Opt-in 'Green / red' candle setting, up. Red-green colour-blind viewers lose hue here; hollow-up / filled-down still carries direction. Never the default.

tokens.name: chart-down-conventional
tokens.usage: Opt-in 'Green / red' candle setting, down. Pairs with chart-up-conventional.

tokens.name: chart-series-1
tokens.usage: First indicator line (e.g. fast MA). Solid.

tokens.name: chart-series-2
tokens.usage: Second indicator line (e.g. slow MA). Solid.

tokens.name: chart-series-3
tokens.usage: Third indicator / Bollinger band edges.

tokens.name: chart-series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth indicator / signal line in MACD.

tokens.name: chart-series-5
tokens.usage: Fifth indicator, a neutral grey-blue so it never competes with the accent; also benchmark 1. Benchmarks reuse series 5,2,3,4 DASHED, so they never look like an indicator.

tokens.name: chart-event-split
tokens.usage: Split marker. Marker carries the letter S.

tokens.name: chart-event-dividend
tokens.usage: Dividend marker. Letter D.

tokens.name: chart-event-earnings
tokens.usage: Earnings marker. Letter E.

tokens.name: chart-selection
tokens.usage: An agent-highlighted range or marker on the canvas (agent work, so accent). A person's own selection uses chart-anchor handles.

tokens.name: chart-drawing
tokens.usage: A person's own drawings (trend lines, rectangles, notes) in a solo workspace. Chosen to stay apart from every candle, series, presence and state colour: smallest difference ΔE 28 (dark) / 29 (light) under normal, protan, deutan and tritan vision. In a shared workspace a person's drawings use their presence colour.

tokens.name: chart-anchor
tokens.usage: Selected drawing handles on the canvas. Neutral ink, like every other selection; never the caution hue.

tokens.name: presence-1
tokens.usage: First invited person (teal)'s avatar ring, cursor and follow-banner edge. People are circles; agents are squircles with the accent ring, so shape, not colour, separates person from agent.

tokens.name: presence-2
tokens.usage: Second invited person (W2).

tokens.name: presence-3
tokens.usage: Third invited person (W2). Presence colours always sit beside initials and a name.

tokens.name: presence-4
tokens.usage: Fourth invited person. Colour supports four people; the fifth person on gets a neutral border-control ring plus initials and a number. Always beside a name.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: Title block: symbol and date range. One per screen.

styles.name: title-panel
styles.usage: Dialog titles, empty-state headline, rail heading.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, section headings in the rail.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: SMA 50 crossed above SMA 200 on the stored daily series.
styles.usage: Base text: messages, descriptions, dialog copy.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Controls, chips, badges, toolbar values, meta row.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Smallest text allowed anywhere. Timestamps, render status, footnotes. Nothing below 11px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels and dl terms. Replaces the 7-9px small caps.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Legend values, facts values, hover readouts. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Evidence blocks, data-run ids, utility commands.

spacing.note: Exact values from the current app's 6/8/12/18 gaps and 30/16 gutters, made into a named scale.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between chips in a row; badge padding-inline.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar controls; card internal row gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in the rail.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel padding; page gutter on phone.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; between title block and chart panel.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, event markers, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, chips.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Chart panel, rail, cards.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the sign-in dialog.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Connection dot, avatars, 44px drag handles.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs only. Panels use borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The in-chart notice card floating over the veiled frame.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every button, input, tab and chip; drag handles.

tokens.name: size-target-compact
tokens.usage: Toolbar icon buttons on desktop only, inside a 44px tall toolbar row. Never on phone.

tokens.name: size-rail-wide
tokens.usage: Right rail at 1440px and wider.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Right rail from 1180px.

tokens.name: size-rail-small
tokens.usage: Right rail from 1024px to 1179px; also the drawer width on tablet.

tokens.name: size-tablet-max
tokens.usage: At this width and below (above phone): the rail becomes a drawer over the chart, opened from the icon strip.

tokens.name: size-railbar
tokens.usage: Width of the rail icon strip: always on tablet, and on desktop when the person collapses the rail.

tokens.name: size-phone-max
tokens.usage: At this width and below: phone layout, Chart / Conversation switch.

tokens.name: size-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, offset 2px.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (always with a reason in a tooltip or caption).
